description: A PHP class representing the User model in the OpenCart admin system; it manages user-related database operations such as creating, updating, deleting users, and handling user login, authorization, and tokens.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Model class for managing user data within the OpenCart admin module, providing CRUD operations and related functionalities.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database with provided user data.

methods.name: editUser
methods.description: Updates an existing user's information in the database based on user ID.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a specified user.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user record and associated authorizations and logins from the database.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a user by their user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves user details by username.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves user details by email.

methods.name: getUserByCode
methods.description: Fetches user information based on a specific code.

methods.name: getUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users, applying optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getTotalUsers
methods.description: Returns the total count of users matching optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByGroupId
methods.description: Counts users belonging to a specific user group.

methods.name: getTotalUsersByEmail
methods.description: Counts users with a specific email.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Records a user login event with IP and user agent.

methods.name: deleteLogins
methods.description: Removes all login records for a specified user.

methods.name: getLogins
methods.description: Fetches login records for a user with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogins
methods.description: Returns total login count for a user.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates an authorization record for a user.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a user authorization.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Sets the total attempts for a specific authorization record.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotalByUserId
methods.description: Updates the total attempts for all authorizations of a user.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Deletes authorization records for a user.

methods.name: getAuthorize
methods.description: Retrieves a specific authorization record by ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Fetches authorization info matching a token and user ID.

methods.name: getAuthorizes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of authorization records for a user.

methods.name: getTotalAuthorizes
methods.description: Counts total authorization records for a user.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets total attempts in authorization records for a user.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a token record for user authentication or actions.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a token record by code, valid for a limited time.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Removes token records matching a specific code.
